item.title: AI struggles to recognize dialects in Swedish hospitals
item.description: Swedish hospitals are increasingly relying on artificial intelligence to automatically transcribe patient admission data, but many doctors warn that the system has serious shortcomings. According to medical staff, the AI struggles to recognize regional dialects—especially the Skåne dialect—leading to frequent errors ranging from simple spelling mistakes to completely nonsensical sentences, Azernews reports.

item.title: Consultative Council of Religious Confessions Sends Letter to President Aliyev
item.description: The Consultative Council of Religious Confessions in Azerbaijan has addressed a letter to Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev.

item.title: Hyundai protests humanoid robot use
item.description: The trade union of Hyundai Motor in South Korea has firmly opposed the use of humanoid robots in production lines without the agreement of employees, Azernews reports.

item.title: China imports last cheap Venezuelan oil
item.description: The final tankers loaded with sanctioned Venezuelan oil before the U.S. blockade and the ousting of Nicolás Maduro are expected to reach China in the coming days, effectively ending years of ultra‑cheap crude supplies to Chinese buyers, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: World’s first luxury design robot unveiled
item.description: The Russian luxury brand Caviar, renowned for its custom smartphones, has taken a bold step into robotics by creating the world’s first luxury-designed robot, based on the Unitree G1 platform, Azernews reports.

item.title: bp supports publication highlighting key facts about the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic
item.description: bp today announced the publication of a new book it has supported - “100 Most Interesting Facts about the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic”, aimed at increasing awareness and interest in the history of Azerbaijan’s first democratic state among a wide audience, Azernews reports.

item.title: SOCAR, Africa and Europe: mapping Azerbaijan’s expanding energy footprint
item.description: SOCAR’s expansion on the international stage now represents a new phase in Azerbaijan’s energy policy. For many years, SOCAR focused primarily on regional projects, managing oil refineries, opening fuel stations, and acting as a supplier. This model provided stable income but kept the company in the role of a secondary player in the global energy market. item.title: TikTok wins green light in US
item.description: TikTok, owned by ByteDance Ltd., announced the creation of a majority American-owned joint venture to ensure its continued operation in the United States, in line with an agreement first outlined by President Donald Trump last September, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: US vice president to visit Azerbaijan, Armenia, Trump says
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced Friday that Vice President JD Vance will visit Azerbaijan and Armenia in February, Azernews reports.

item.title: Lula accuses Trump of building 'new UN'
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said Friday that U.S. President Donald Trump attempts to create a new United Nations and be its sole owner, Azernews reports.
